findings.detail: runAudit currently admits every positive batch, calls buildFor, and runs the arithmetic phase before invoking test-packed-storage-cuda. The newly mandatory storage fixture has a compile-time1..64 batch contract, so this accepted request inevitably fails after avoidable client build/arithmetic work on the GPU allocation. The measured B16 preset is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Validate the tiled-audit batch range1..64 before buildFor, and give a specific error. Preserve positive batches for the untiled legacy path. Add boundary controls for1/64 and rejection before build/storage/timing for65.
findings.title: Reject unsupported tiled-audit batches before building

findings.detail: The fixture has a TILE256 baked binary with256 threads, but the runBench call omits threads and therefore uses its128-thread default. It raises the matching-baked-binary error even when the compact-state identity is unchanged, so the assertion would not catch losing the compact key from the no-rebuild comparison. The current production comparison does include the correct key.
findings.recommendation: Pass threads=256 for this assertion and include a matching-mode success control at the same geometry before toggling compact mode.
findings.title: Isolate compact-mode mismatch in the no-rebuild test
